Tooltip_ReticleTextDisplayMode: Style for storage container hover text. Default: X items, Y free slots. Slots only: X/Y slots occupied. Disabled: no hover text.
Tooltip_PreviewUI: Shows a popup UI with the storage container's contents when looking at it.
Tooltip_PreviewUIBackground: Adds dark background behind the Preview UI to improve visibility.
Tooltip_PreviewUIBackgroundOpacity: Adjusts colour of dark preview UI background Range:0 (translucent) to 100% (solid colour).
Tooltip_PreviewUIAnchorX: Moves the preview UI left/right on screen Range:0 (left edge) to 1 (right edge).
Tooltip_PreviewUIAnchorY: Moves the preview UI up/down on screen Range:0 (bottom) to 1 (top).
